examples.title: Export control: U.S. persons only
examples.text:
Ferrous Dynamics is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer in Denver, CO.

You will own CAD models and tolerance analysis for propulsion test hardware.

Requirements
- 2+ years with SolidWorks or NX
- Hands-on test lab experience

Due to export control regulations (ITAR), candidates must be U.S. persons as defined by 22 CFR 120.62.

examples.title: Offers sponsorship, then rules it out
examples.text:
Marigold Payments - Staff Software Engineer, Risk (San Francisco, CA)

Lead the design of real-time fraud scoring across our card network.

Why join us
- Meaningful equity and a competitive salary
- We are happy to sponsor visas for exceptional candidates.

Requirements
- 8+ years of backend engineering
- Experience with streaming systems such as Kafka or Flink

Legal
Candidates must be able to work in the US without sponsorship. Marigold Payments is an equal opportunity employer.
